environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at instance). No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Instance runs the Flask app via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database on local EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener, no HTTP inspection
